claims.quote: The Opal Licorice Gourami is endemic to Central Kalimantan in Indonesian Borneo.
Parosphromenus opallios is a liquorice gourami endemic to Central Kalimantan province in Indonesian Borneo, in the Arut and Benipah river systems.
